subject: maths
question: John walks around a circular field at the rate of one round per hour while Sonu runs around its at the rate of seven rounds per hour. They start in the same direction from the same point at 9.35 am. At what time will they first cross each other?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Rₛ = Sₛ - Sj, where-

Rₛ = Relative speed

Sₛ = Speed of Sonu

Sj = Speed of John

**Calculation:**

Rₛ = 7 - 1 = 6 rounds per hour.

Time taken to complete 1 round = 1over6 hour or 10 min.

Time at which they would cross = 9.35 am + 10 min = 9.45 am.

**∴ They would cross each other at 9.45 am.**
